thread:
sarah: FYI MaplePay reported ~20 autopay invoice failures in the last hour. Symptoms: 1) immediate decline code `insufficient_funds` for some cards, 2) a subset sees 3DS redirect -> ACS times out and we return `authentication_required`. Can we triage?

alex: Thanks — any example txn IDs or request/response logs?

sarah: Pushed one example to the incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-12345. Example payment id: pay_3K7a9L. Log snippet:```json
{"payment_id":"pay_3K7a9L","status":"failed","decline_code":"insufficient_funds","gateway_response":{"acquirer_code":"51","message":"Insufficient funds"}}
```

lia: Quick note — if both `insufficient_funds` and 3DS timeouts are happening, could be dual root causes: real issuer NSF + our retry path triggering additional ACS flows. Do we have gateway / acquirer mapping for these times? @ops-bot can you pull gateway mappings for that merchant?

ops-bot: Retrieved mapping for merchant MAPLEPAY (id m_984): primary_acquirer: willow-pay, fallback_acquirer: ember-gw, routing_policy: standard. Logs for pay_3K7a9L attached to ticket.

rohit: I ran a smoke repro against their saved instrument via sandbox (using a test card that simulates NSF + ACS). Repro commands:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/payments 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
 -d '{"merchant_id":"m_984","amount":12500,"currency":"usd","card_token":"tok_test_nsf_3ds","auto_capture":true}'
```
Repro: first call returns `insufficient_funds` (gateway 51), repeated attempt within 30s triggers a redirect to ACS and then we see ACS timeout ~12s -> we mark as `authentication_required`.

alex: That matches what the merchant described. Two actionable items: 1) confirm we are not double-retrying on our side (we should not retry on immediate 51 declines), 2) check if routing fallback is causing a different acquirer to force 3DS for the same card.

lia: Checked our retry middleware — we only auto-retry on network/error codes (5xx, timeouts) and on `processor_timed_out`. We do NOT retry on `decline_code` 51. So looks like something upstream (merchant checkout) might be re-submitting, or a webhook-triggered retry.

rohit: I grep'd the logs for pay_3K7a9L — there are two inbound requests within 18s from merchant IP 34.82.91.12, both with same saved_card_id. The first gets 51 from willow-pay, then the merchant backend issues a follow-up attempt which our routing policy sends to ember-gw (fallback). Ember-gw enforces SCA and sends ACS redirect -> ACS times out. So sequence explains both failure modes.

alex: Good find. We should update the incident with repro and recommend merchant stop auto-retrying failed charges for immediate declines. Also add an operational mitigation: temporarily pin merchant to primary_acquirer only (avoid fallback) until they fix retry logic. Lia, can you apply acquirer pin for m_984 and monitor?

lia: On it. Applying `acquirer_pin: willow-pay` for merchant m_984 now. Patch: `PATCH /v1/merchants/m_984/config {"acquirer_pin":"willow-pay"}` -> 200 OK.

ops-bot: Deploy note: routing-config change applied to region us-west-2 at 2025-11-15T14:12:28Z by lia.

alex: After pinning, can someone ask MaplePay to retry a few failed invoices (not auto) and confirm results? I emailed the rep with steps.

sarah: Merchant retried 5 failed invoices manually — 4 succeeded, 1 still failed with 51. They've paused their automatic retrying. Rep says good for now.

rohit: I'll open a small task to add a telemetry alert for rapid duplicate attempts on the same saved_card_id within 60s so we can surface merchant-side retry storms.

alex: Agreed. Also add a KB note for support: "Do not auto-retry on immediate issuer declines (51, 54); coordinate with merchant to do manual retries after customer contact."

lia: Closing note: root cause = combination of issuer insufficient funds + merchant auto-retries -> fallback acquirer enforcing SCA -> ACS timeouts. Mitigation = acquirer pin + merchant pause retries. Will monitor 6h. :white_check_mark:
